en.s: The Battle of Fulford was fought on the outskirts of the village of Fulford near York in England, on 20 September 1066, when King Harald III of Norway, also known as Harald Hardrada ("harðráði" in Old Norse, meaning "hard ruler"), and Tostig Godwinson, his English ally, fought and defeated the Northern Earls Edwin and Morcar. Tostig was Harold Godwinson's banished brother. He had allied with King Harald of Norway and possibly Duke William of Normandy but there is no record of the reasoning behind his invasions. The battle was a decisive victory for the Viking army.

zh.s: 1066年9月20日，挪威国王哈拉尔三世（又称“严酷者”哈拉尔，古诺尔斯语“harðráði”意为“严厉的统治者”）和他的英国盟友托斯蒂格·戈德温森，在英格兰约克附近的富尔福德村郊外与北方伯爵埃德温和莫卡交战并将其击败。托斯蒂格是哈罗德·戈德温森的兄弟，后来被哈罗德放逐。他与挪威国王哈拉尔结盟，也可能与诺曼底公爵威廉结盟，但没有史料说明这些入侵行动背后的原因。这场战斗以维京军队决定性胜利告终。

en.s: The siege of Jerusalem lasted from 20 September to 2 October 1187, when Balian of Ibelin surrendered the city to the forces of the Ayyubid Sultanate under sultan Saladin. Earlier that summer, Egyptian forces under Saladin had defeated the kingdom's army and conquered several cities. Balian was charged with organizing a defense. The city was full of refugees but had few soldiers.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷围城战从1187年9月20日持续至10月2日。伊贝林的巴利安最终将城池交给萨拉丁统率的阿尤布王朝军队。那年夏天早些时候，萨拉丁率领埃及军队击败耶路撒冷王国的军队，并攻占数座城市。巴利安受命组织城防。城中挤满了难民，但守军人数不多。

en.s: The Prussian uprisings were two major and three smaller uprisings by the Old Prussians, one of the Baltic tribes, against the Teutonic Knights that took place in the 13th century during the Prussian Crusade. The crusading military order, supported by the Popes and Christian Europe, sought to conquer and convert the pagan Prussians.

zh.s: 普鲁士起义包括13世纪普鲁士十字军东征期间，波罗的海古普鲁士人针对条顿骑士团发动的两次大规模起义和三次较小起义。教宗和基督教欧洲支持的十字军军事修会试图征服古普鲁士人并使其皈依基督教。

en.s: The Battle of Myton, nicknamed the Chapter of Myton or The White Battle because of the number of clergy involved, was a major engagement in the First Scottish War of Independence, fought in Yorkshire on 20 September 1319.

zh.s: 迈顿战役是第一次苏格兰独立战争中的一场重要战斗，于1319年9月20日在约克郡进行。由于有许多神职人员参战，这场战役又称“迈顿教士之战”或“白色之战”。

en.s: The 1498 Nankai earthquake (明応地震 Meiō Jishin) occurred off the coast of Nankaidō, Japan, at about 08:00 local time on 20 September 1498. It had a magnitude estimated at 8.6 MS and triggered a large tsunami. The death toll associated with this event is uncertain, but between 26,000 and 31,000 casualties were reported. A tsunami caused by the Meiō Nankaidō earthquake washed away the building housing the statue of the Great Buddha at Kōtoku-in in Kamakura.

zh.s: 1498年南海地震（日语：明应地震，Meiō Jishin）于1498年9月20日当地时间约8时在日本南海道近海发生，估计面波震级为8.6级，并引发大海啸。此次事件的确切死亡人数不明，相关资料报告的伤亡人数为26,000至31,000人。海啸还冲毁了镰仓高德院安置大佛像的建筑。

en.s: The Battle of Toropets was fought during the Livonian War, between Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Tsardom of Russia in September 20, 1580. Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Janusz Zbaraski defeated the Russian forces commanded by Dimitrij Cheremisov and Grigorij Nashchokin.

zh.s: 托罗佩茨战役发生于1580年9月20日，是利沃尼亚战争期间波兰立陶宛联邦与俄罗斯沙皇国之间的一场战斗。扬努什·兹巴拉斯基率领波兰立陶宛联邦军队，击败了德米特里·切列米索夫和格里戈里·纳什乔金指挥的俄军。

en.s: The siege of Székesfehérvár also known as the siege of Stuhlweissenburg (French: Prise d'Albe-Royale, German: Belagerung von Stuhlweißenburg, Turkish: İstolni Belgrad) began on 4 September 1601 when an Imperial force sent by Holy Roman emperor Rudolf II, under the command of Frenchman Philippe Emmanuel de Lorraine, duc de Mercoeur, besieged the Hungarian fortress of Székesfehérvár occupied by the Ottomans since 1543.

zh.s: 塞克什白堡围城战又称斯图尔魏森堡围城战（法语：Prise d’Albe-Royale；德语：Belagerung von Stuhlweißenburg；土耳其语：İstolni Belgrad）。1601年9月4日，神圣罗马帝国皇帝鲁道夫二世派出一支帝国军队，由法国人梅克伦堡公爵菲利普·埃马纽埃尔·德·洛林率领，围攻这座匈牙利要塞。自1543年以来，该城一直被奥斯曼帝国占领。

en.s: The siege of Grave was a siege that took place between 18 July and 20 September 1602, as part of the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. The Spanish-held city of Grave was besieged by a Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange and Francis Vere respectively. After a siege of nearly two months the city surrendered when a Spanish relief army under Francisco de Mendoza was defeated just outside the city by the besiegers.

zh.s: 格雷夫围城战于1602年7月18日至9月20日发生，是八十年战争和英西战争的一部分。荷兰和英国联军分别由奥兰治的莫里斯和弗朗西斯·维尔率领，围攻由西班牙控制的格雷夫城。围困近两个月后，围城方在城外击败了弗朗西斯科·德·门多萨率领的西班牙援军，格雷夫随即投降。

en.s: The Battle of Guidjel, or Battle of Guedjal, was a battle between the regency of Algiers and feudal lords of the Beylik of Constantine, including Sheikh Ahmed ben Sakheri ben Bouokkaz, cheikh el arab of the Beylik and Betka-el-Moqrani, Sultan of the Beni Abbès .

zh.s: 吉杰尔战役是阿尔及尔摄政领与君士坦丁贝伊领的封建领主之间的一场战斗。参战者包括贝伊领的阿拉伯酋长谢赫·艾哈迈德·本·萨赫里·本·布瓦卡兹，以及贝尼·阿巴斯苏丹贝特卡·穆克拉尼。

en.s: The 1640 siege of Turin (22 May–20 September 1640) was a major action in two distinct wars: the Franco-Spanish War (1635–59) and the Piedmontese Civil War. When Thomas Francis, Prince of Carignano and his Piedmontese faction captured Turin, the French garrison supporting the Regent Christine Marie of France retired within the citadel and continued to resist.

zh.s: 1640年的都灵围城战（1640年5月22日至9月20日）是两场战争中的重要战事：1635年至1659年的法西战争和皮埃蒙特内战。卡里尼亚诺亲王托马斯·弗朗西斯及其皮埃蒙特派系攻占都灵后，支持法国摄政王克里斯蒂娜·玛丽的法军守备部队退入城堡，继续抵抗。

en.s: The First Battle of Newbury was a battle of the First English Civil War that was fought on 20 September 1643 between a Royalist army, under the personal command of King Charles, and a Parliamentarian force led by the Earl of Essex. Following a year of Royalist successes in which they took Banbury, Oxford and Reading without conflict before storming Bristol, the Parliamentarians were left without an effective army in the field. When Charles laid siege to Gloucester, Parliament was forced to muster a force under Essex with which to beat Charles's forces off.

zh.s: 第一次纽伯里战役是第一次英国内战中的一场战斗，于1643年9月20日爆发，交战双方是由查理国王亲自指挥的保王军和埃塞克斯伯爵率领的议会军。此前一年，保王军接连获胜，不战而取班伯里、牛津和雷丁，随后又强攻布里斯托尔，使议会军失去了能在战场上有效作战的军队。查理围攻格洛斯特后，议会被迫在埃塞克斯指挥下集结军队，击退查理的部队。

en.t: Stand-off at the Fords of Arkaig
en.s: The Stand-off at the Ford of Arkaig occurred in September 1665 at Achnacarry, about 10 miles (16 km) northeast of Fort William, Scotland. The Chattan Confederation led by the Clan Mackintosh assembled an army to challenge Clan Cameron in a 360-year-old dispute over the lands around Loch Arkaig. After a week of stalemate, the long-running feud was ended by a deal in which the Camerons bought the land from the Mackintoshes.

zh.s: 阿凯格浅滩对峙于1665年9月发生在阿赫纳卡里，那里位于苏格兰威廉堡东北约10英里（16公里）处。查坦联盟在麦金托什氏族带领下集结军队，准备挑战卡梅伦氏族；双方为阿凯格湖周边土地的归属争执了360年。僵持一周后，双方达成协议，卡梅伦氏族向麦金托什氏族购买土地，这场长期争端就此结束。

en.t: The Treaty of Ryswick is signed by France, England, Spain, the Holy Roman Empire and the Dutch Republic, ending the Nine Years' War
en.s: The Peace of Ryswick, or Rijswijk, were a series of treaties signed in the Dutch city of Rijswijk between 20 September and 30 October 1697. They ended the 1688 to 1697 Nine Years' War between France and the Grand Alliance, which included the Dutch Republic, the Holy Roman Empire, England, Scotland, and Spain.

zh.s: 里斯维克和约又称莱斯韦克和约，是一系列于1697年9月20日至10月30日在荷兰里斯韦克签署的条约。这些条约结束了1688年至1697年的九年战争。战争交战双方是法国与大同盟；大同盟成员包括荷兰共和国、神圣罗马帝国、英格兰、苏格兰和西班牙。

en.s: King William's War was the North American theater of the Nine Years' War (1688–1697). It was the first of six colonial wars (see the four French and Indian Wars, Father Rale's War and Father Le Loutre's War) fought between New France and New England along with their respective Native allies before France ceded its remaining mainland territories in North America east of the Mississippi River in 1763.

zh.s: 威廉王之战是九年战争（1688—1697）在北美的战场。它是六场殖民战争中的第一场（其余包括四场法印战争、拉尔神父战争和勒卢特神父战争）。这些战争由新法兰西与新英格兰及各自的原住民盟友交战；直到1763年，法国才将密西西比河以东在北美大陆的剩余领土割让出去。

en.s: The Battle of Samothrace was an inconclusive battle which took place on 20 September 1698 near Samothrace, Greece. It was between Venice on one side, and Ottoman Empire and its Tripolitanian and Tunisian allies on the other. Venetian casualties were 299 killed and 622 wounded.

zh.s: 1698年9月20日，萨莫色雷斯附近发生了一场未分胜负的战斗。交战一方是威尼斯，另一方是奥斯曼帝国以及的黎波里和突尼斯盟军。威尼斯军伤亡为299人阵亡、622人受伤。

en.s: The First Battle of Höchstädt was fought on 20 September 1703, near Höchstädt in Bavaria, and resulted in a French-Bavarian victory under Marshal Villars against the Austrians under General Hermann Otto of Limburg Styrum. The battle was part of the War of the Spanish Succession (1701–1714) over who had the right to succeed Charles II as king of Spain.

zh.t: 第一次赫希施泰特战役
zh.s: 第一次赫希施泰特战役于1703年9月20日在巴伐利亚赫希施泰特附近进行。维拉尔元帅率领的法巴联军击败了赫尔曼·奥托·冯·林堡-施蒂鲁姆将军指挥的奥地利军队。战斗属于西班牙王位继承战争（1701—1714年），这场战争围绕谁有权继承查理二世的西班牙王位而展开。

en.s: The Battle of Rajovka took place on 20 September 1708 near Rayevka, Smolensk during the Swedish invasion of Russia in the Great Northern War. The Swedish army of about 2,400 men under the command of Charles XII defeated the Russian army of 10,000 men under Christian Felix Bauer after a fierce cavalry skirmish where the king himself was in great danger.

zh.s: 1708年9月20日，大北方战争期间，瑞典入侵俄罗斯时在斯摩棱斯克附近的拉耶夫卡发生拉约夫卡战役。查理十二世率领约2400名瑞典军，击败了克里斯蒂安·费利克斯·鲍尔指挥的1万名俄军。双方发生激烈的骑兵交战，瑞典国王本人也一度身陷险境。

en.s: The Battle of Paoli (also known as the Battle of Paoli Tavern or the Paoli Massacre) was a battle in the Philadelphia campaign of the American Revolutionary War fought on September 20, 1777, in the area surrounding present-day Malvern, Pennsylvania. Following the American retreats at the Battle of Brandywine and the Battle of the Clouds, George Washington left a force under Brigadier General Anthony Wayne behind to monitor and harass the British as they prepared to move on the revolutionary capital of Philadelphia. On the evening of September 20, British forces under Major General Charles Grey led a surprise attack on Wayne's encampment near the Paoli Tavern.

zh.s: 帕奥利战役又称帕奥利酒馆战役或帕奥利大屠杀，是美国独立战争费城战役中的一场战斗，于1777年9月20日在今宾夕法尼亚州马尔文一带进行。布兰迪万战役和云层战役后，美军接连撤退。乔治·华盛顿留下安东尼·韦恩准将指挥的一支部队，监视并袭扰正准备进军革命首都费城的英军。9月20日晚，查尔斯·格雷少将率领英军突袭韦恩在帕奥利酒馆附近的营地。

en.s: The Battle of Valmy was the first major victory by the army of France during the Revolutionary Wars that followed the French Revolution. The action took place on 20 September 1792 as Prussian troops commanded by the Duke of Brunswick attempted to march on Paris. Generals François Kellermann and Charles Dumouriez stopped the advance near the northern village of Valmy in Champagne-Ardenne. In this early part of the Revolutionary Wars—known as the War of the First Coalition—the new French government was in almost every way unproven, and thus the small, localized victory at Valmy became a huge psychological victory for the Revolution at large.

zh.s: 瓦尔密战役是法国军队在法国大革命后的革命战争中取得的首场重大胜利。1792年9月20日，不伦瑞克公爵率领的普鲁士军队试图向巴黎进军，战斗由此爆发。弗朗索瓦·凯勒曼和夏尔·迪穆里耶将军在香槟-阿登北部的瓦尔密村附近挡住了普军。革命战争初期，法国新政府在各方面都还未经考验，因此这场规模不大、局限于当地的胜利，对整个革命运动产生了巨大的鼓舞作用。

en.s: The Battle of Pont-Barré (20 September 1793) saw Royalist Vendeans under Pierre Duhoux and Dominique Piron de La Varenne fighting a Republican French column under Charles François Duhoux near Saint-Lambert-du-Lattay. Duhoux's Republican column advanced southwest from Angers and encountered Vendean defenders led by his nephew Pierre at the bridge (French: pont) over the Layon River. The rebels held their ground until reinforcements under Piron La Varenne arrived and gained the upper hand. The Vendeans put the Republicans to flight, killing 1,362 soldiers and capturing all their artillery. The action was part of a Republican strategy of invading the Vendée from several different directions.

zh.s: 蓬巴雷战役发生于1793年9月20日，旺代保王军在皮埃尔·迪乌和多米尼克·皮隆·德·拉瓦雷纳率领下，在圣朗贝尔迪拉特莱附近与夏尔-弗朗索瓦·迪乌率领的法国共和军纵队交战。共和军纵队从昂热向西南推进，在莱永河桥（法语：pont）附近遇到由迪乌的侄子皮埃尔率领的旺代守军。叛军坚守阵地，直到皮隆·德·拉瓦雷纳率领的援军赶到并占据上风。旺代军将共和军击溃，打死1362名士兵，并缴获全部火炮。这次战斗是共和军从多个方向进攻旺代战略的一部分。

en.s: Partial legislative elections were held in France on 20 September 1817, during the Second Restoration, to choose delegates to the Chamber of Deputies. It was the first of three elections (the others coming in 1818 and 1819) under a new law that called for legislative elections to be held annually in one-fifth of the nation's departments. The election was a clear defeat for the Ultras, who lost all their seats.

zh.s: 法国于1817年9月20日举行部分立法选举，选出众议院议员。当时处于波旁王朝第二次复辟时期。这是新选举法下三次选举中的第一次，另外两次于1818年和1819年举行。新法规定，每年在全国五分之一的省份举行立法选举。极端保王派在此次选举中遭遇惨败，失去了全部席位。

en.s: The Ragamuffin War (Portuguese: Guerra dos Farrapos), also known as the Ragamuffin Revolution or Heroic Decade, was a republican uprising that began in southern Brazil during the regency period, centered in the province of Rio Grande do Sul and, for a time, extending into Santa Catarina. It began on 20 September 1835, when rebel forces seized Porto Alegre, and soon turned into a wider confrontation between Brazil's imperial government and a coalition led by Bento Gonçalves and Antônio de Sousa Neto, who proclaimed the secession of the province and the creation of the Riograndense Republic following the rebel victory at the battle of Seival in 1836.

zh.s: 拉加穆芬战争（葡萄牙语：Guerra dos Farrapos）又称拉加穆芬革命或英雄十年，是摄政时期在巴西南部爆发的一场共和主义起义，中心位于南里奥格兰德省，一度扩展至圣卡塔琳娜省。1835年9月20日，叛军攻占阿雷格里港，起义由此开始。随后，巴西帝国政府与一支联盟展开更广泛的冲突；联盟由本托·贡萨尔维斯和安东尼奥·德·索萨·内图领导，他们在1836年塞瓦尔战役获胜后宣布该省脱离巴西，并成立南里奥格兰德共和国。

en.s: The capture of Porto Alegre was one of the starting points of the Ragamuffin War. It took place on 20 September 1835, the day after the Battle of Azenha Bridge. Its date has been celebrated as a state holiday in Rio Grande do Sul since 1995 and also marks the end of Farroupilha Week, between the 14th and 20th of September.

zh.s: 攻占阿雷格里港是拉加穆芬战争的起点之一，发生于1835年9月20日，也就是阿泽尼亚桥战役后的第二天。自1995年以来，这一天一直是南里奥格兰德州的州假日，也标志着法鲁皮利亚周（9月14日至20日）结束。

en.s: The Battle of Villarrobledo was a battle of the First Carlist War, occurring on September 20, 1836, south of Villarrobledo at a campground called Vega de San Cristóbal, which lies near a hermitage of the same name. However, there were also casualties reported in Villarrobledo proper. The forces engaged in the battle consisted of ISABELINOS 3rd Division: Gen. Alaix- I and II bat. Principe- I and II bat. Cordova- I and II bat. Almansa- 4 Guides coys.Cavalry: D. Diego de Leon- Princess Hussars (150 troopers)- 1st and 5th Light Cavalry (200 troopers)TOTAL: 4000 inf and 350 cav CARLISTASGen.

zh.s: 比利亚罗夫莱多战役是第一次卡洛斯战争中的一场战斗，于1836年9月20日在比利亚罗夫莱多以南的圣克里斯托瓦尔谷营地发生，地点靠近一座同名隐修院。比利亚罗夫莱多镇内也有伤亡报告。

en.s: The Battle of the Alma (short for Battle of the Alma River) took place during the Crimean War between an allied expeditionary force (made up of French, British, and Ottoman forces) and Russian forces defending the Crimean Peninsula on 20 September 1854. The allies had made a surprise landing in Crimea on 14 September.

zh.s: 阿尔马河战役是克里米亚战争期间的一场战斗，发生于1854年9月20日。交战双方是一支由法国、英国和奥斯曼军队组成的盟军远征军，以及守卫克里米亚半岛的俄军。盟军于9月14日在克里米亚突然登陆。

en.s: The Battle of Panther Creek (also known as Battle of Sutherland's Hill) was fought on September 20, 1862, south of Owensboro, Kentucky. It was the only battle that took place in Daviess County, Kentucky during the American Civil War. On July 18, 1862, a small Confederate force of about 35 men led by Colonel Adam Rankin Johnson launched a successful raid on the small town of Newburgh, Indiana.

zh.s: 黑豹溪战役又称萨瑟兰山战役，于1862年9月20日在肯塔基州欧文斯伯勒以南进行，是美国内战期间戴维斯县境内唯一的一场战斗。1862年7月18日，亚当·兰金·约翰逊上校率领约35名邦联军袭击印第安纳州小镇纽堡，并成功突袭。

en.s: The Battle of Chickamauga, fought on September 18–20, 1863, between the United States Army, or Union Army, and Confederate forces in the American Civil War, marked the end of a U.S. Army offensive, the Chickamauga Campaign, in southeastern Tennessee and northwestern Georgia. It was the first major battle of the war fought in Georgia and the most significant Union defeat in the Western Theater, and it involved the second-highest number of casualties after the Battle of Gettysburg.
en.n: American Civil War: The Battle of Chickamauga, in northwestern Georgia, ends in a Confederate victory.

zh.s: 奇卡莫加战役于1863年9月18日至20日在田纳西州东南部和佐治亚州西北部进行，交战双方是美国内战中的联邦军和邦联军。战役结束了联邦军在奇卡莫加战役行动中的一次攻势。它是内战期间佐治亚州境内的首场重大战役，也是西部战区联邦军最严重的一次败仗；参战伤亡人数仅次于葛底斯堡战役。
zh.n: 美国内战：奇卡莫加战役以邦联军获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Villa del Pilar took place during the Paraguayan War. Brazilian forces, under the command of then Colonel Rufino Eneias Gustavo Galvão, advanced on the village on September 20, 1867. About 250 Paraguayan soldiers resisted the attack, and Francisco Solano López ordered Colonel Felipe Toledo to send aid. There were 300 Brazilian casualties against 174 on the Paraguayan side.

zh.s: 皮拉尔城战役发生在巴拉圭战争期间。1867年9月20日，鲁菲诺·埃内亚斯·古斯塔沃·加尔旺上校率领巴西军队向村庄推进。约250名巴拉圭士兵抵抗进攻，弗朗西斯科·索拉诺·洛佩斯命令费利佩·托莱多上校派兵增援。巴西方面有300人伤亡，巴拉圭方面有174人伤亡。

en.s: The capture of Rome (Italian: Presa di Roma) occurred on 20 September 1870, as forces of the Kingdom of Italy took control of the city and of the Papal States. After a plebiscite held on 2 October 1870, Rome was officially made capital of Italy on 3 February 1871, completing the unification of Italy (Risorgimento).

zh.s: 1870年9月20日，意大利王国军队攻占罗马和教皇国。1870年10月2日举行公民投票后，罗马于1871年2月3日正式成为意大利首都，意大利统一运动（复兴运动）由此完成。

en.s: The Ganghwa Island incident or the Japanese Battle of Ganghwa (Korean: 운요호 사건 [雲揚號事件] Unyo-ho sageon meaning "Un'yō incident"; Japanese: 江華島事件 Kōka-tō jiken) was an armed clash between the Joseon dynasty of Korea and Japan which occurred in the vicinity of Ganghwa Island on September 20, 1875.

en.s: The Battle of Zanzibar was an encounter between the German Kaiserliche Marine and the British Royal Navy early in the First World War. While taking on coal in the delta of the Rufiji River in German East Africa, the German cruiser SMS Königsberg learned that a British cruiser, HMS Pegasus, which had been part of the Royal Navy's Cape Squadron sent to counter Königsberg, had put in at Zanzibar for repairs. Königsberg's captain, Commander Max Looff, decided to attack Pegasus while she was in port. On 20 September 1914 Königsberg sailed past the picket ship HMS Helmuth at the entrance to Zanzibar harbour.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战初期，德国帝国海军与英国皇家海军在桑给巴尔发生交战。德国巡洋舰“柯尼斯堡”号在德属东非鲁菲吉河三角洲补煤时，得知英国巡洋舰“飞马”号已停靠桑给巴尔维修。“飞马”号隶属皇家海军开普分舰队，该舰队奉命拦截“柯尼斯堡”号。“柯尼斯堡”号舰长马克斯·卢夫海军少校决定趁“飞马”号停泊时发动攻击。1914年9月20日，“柯尼斯堡”号驶过桑给巴尔港入口处的警戒舰“赫尔穆特”号。

en.s: (Main article: Battle of the Menin Road Ridge) The Capture of Wurst Farm was an attack by the British 58th (2/1st London) Division (58th Division) against the German 36th Division on 20 September 1917, near Ypres, Belgium, during the Battle of the Menin Road Ridge, part of the Third Battle of Ypres (Battle of Passchendaele). Wurst Farm was at the lower end of Gravenstafel Ridge and several British attacks in the area since 31 July had been repulsed by the Germans.

zh.s: 1917年9月20日，英国第58（伦敦第2/1）师在比利时伊普尔附近向德国第36师发起进攻，攻占沃斯特农场。这场战斗属于梅宁路山脊战役，也是第三次伊普尔战役（帕斯尚尔战役）的一部分。沃斯特农场位于格拉芬斯塔费尔山脊的低处；自7月31日以来，英军在该地区发动的数次进攻都被德军击退。

en.s: The Capture of Afulah and Beisan occurred on 20 September 1918, during the Battle of Sharon which together with the Nablus, formed the set piece Battle of Megiddo fought during the last months of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. During the cavalry phase of the Battle of Sharon, the 4th Cavalry Division of the Desert Mounted Corps attacked and captured the main communications hub at Afulah, located in the centre of the Esdraelon Plain (also known as the Jezreel Valley and the plain of Armageddon), and Beisan on the plain's eastern edge near the Jordan River, some 40–50 miles (64–80 km) behind the front line in the Judean Hills.

zh.t: 攻占阿富拉和贝特谢安
zh.s: 1918年9月20日，沙龙战役期间，英军攻占阿富拉和贝特谢安。沙龙战役与纳布卢斯战役共同构成米吉多会战，属于第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役的最后阶段。在沙龙战役的骑兵作战阶段，沙漠骑兵军第4骑兵师发动进攻，攻占了耶斯列平原（又称埃斯德赖隆平原或《圣经》中的哈米吉多顿平原）中央的主要交通枢纽阿富拉，以及位于平原东缘、靠近约旦河的贝特谢安。两地都在犹地亚山前线后方约40至50英里（64至80公里）处。

en.s: The Dagestan Campaign (Turkish: Dağıstan Seferi) was a battle between the Ottoman Empire and Russia that happened right after the Battle of Baku during World War I. After the victory in Baku, Ottoman soldiers occupied the Dagestani cities of Derbent and Port-Petrovsk. However, the Ottoman Empire was defeated and the territories were seized by the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，达吉斯坦战役是奥斯曼帝国与俄罗斯之间的一场战斗，发生在巴库战役之后。奥斯曼军队在巴库获胜后，占领了达吉斯坦的杰尔宾特和彼得罗夫斯克港。随后奥斯曼帝国战败，这些地区被俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国夺取。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Echuca on 20 September 1919. This was triggered by the death of Nationalist MP Albert Palmer. The by-election was won by William Hill, endorsed by the Victorian Farmers' Union, who became the second "Country" member of the Parliament following William Gibson's victory in the 1918 Corangamite by-election.

zh.s: 1919年9月20日，澳大利亚众议院埃丘卡选区举行补选。此前，民族党议员阿尔伯特·帕尔默去世，触发了这次补选。维多利亚州农民联盟支持的威廉·希尔赢得选举；继威廉·吉布森在1918年科朗加米特补选中胜出后，他成为议会第二位“乡村党”议员。

en.s: The sack of Balbriggan took place on the night of 20 September 1920, during the Irish War of Independence. Auxiliary members of the Royal Irish Constabulary known as "Black and Tans" went on a rampage in the small town of Balbriggan, County Dublin, burning more than fifty homes and businesses, looting, and killing two local men. Many locals were left jobless and homeless.

zh.s: 1920年9月20日晚，爱尔兰独立战争期间，皇家爱尔兰警察部队的辅助警察队员（被称为“黑棕军”）在都柏林郡巴尔布里根镇横行肆虐。他们焚毁50多所民宅和商铺，洗劫财物，并杀害两名当地男子。许多居民因此失业、无家可归。

en.t: 1921 United States Senate special election in New Mexico
en.s: There was a single special election in 1921 to the United States Senate. It was held in New Mexico for the Class 2 seat, previously held by Albert B. Fall, who resigned March 3, 1921 to become U.S. Secretary of the Interior. Holm O. Bursum was appointed March 11, 1921 to replace him until this special election. On September 20, 1921, he also won the election.

zh.t: 1921年新墨西哥州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1921年美国参议院举行了一次特别选举，填补新墨西哥州的第二类席位。该席位原由艾伯特·B·福尔担任；他于1921年3月3日辞职，出任美国内政部长。3月11日，霍尔姆·O·伯瑟姆获任命接替他，暂任至特别选举举行。1921年9月20日，伯瑟姆也在选举中获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Grodno took place between 20 September and 22 September 1939, during the Soviet invasion of Poland. It was fought between improvised Polish units under General Wacław Przeździecki and Soviet Red Army troops of Komkor Ivan Boldin's Dzerzhinsky Cavalry Mechanized Group, at the time in a non-aggression agreement with Nazi Germany under the Ribbentrop-Molotov Pact.

zh.s: 格罗德诺战役于1939年9月20日至22日爆发，发生在苏联入侵波兰期间。波兰临时编成的部队由瓦茨瓦夫·普热兹杰茨基将军指挥，对阵苏联红军伊万·博尔金军长指挥的捷尔任斯基骑兵机械化集群。当时，苏联已与纳粹德国签署《里宾特洛甫-莫洛托夫条约》，双方承诺互不侵犯。

en.s: The Battle of Kampinos Forest was in fact a series of skirmishes and battles fought in the forests around Kampinos during the Invasion of Poland of 1939, between the Polish Army and the German Wehrmacht. By 16 September, the remnants of the Polish Wielkopolska Cavalry Brigade, the Podolska Cavalry Brigade, and the 15th and 25th Infantry Divisions, broke out of the Bzura Pocket into the Kampinos Forest.

en.t: The Holocaust in Lithuania: Lithuanian Nazis and local police begin a mass execution of 403 Jews in Nemenčinė
en.s: The Holocaust resulted in the near total eradication of Lithuanian (Litvaks) and Polish Jews[a] in Generalbezirk Litauen of the Reichskommissariat Ostland in the Nazi-controlled Lithuania. Of approximately 208,000–210,000 Jews at the time of the Nazi invasion, an estimated 190,000 to 195,000 were killed before the end of World War II, most of them between June and December 1941. This genocide would also mark the beginning of Hitler's Final Solution.

zh.t: 立陶宛大屠杀：立陶宛纳粹分子和当地警察在内门奇内开始大规模处决403名犹太人
zh.s: 纳粹德国控制立陶宛期间，奥斯特兰总督辖区立陶宛地区的立陶宛犹太人（立陶宛犹太族）和波兰犹太人几乎被全部屠杀。纳粹入侵时，当地约有208,000至210,000名犹太人；第二次世界大战结束前，估计有190,000至195,000人被杀，其中大多数死于1941年6月至12月。这场种族灭绝也标志着希特勒“最终解决方案”的开始。

en.s: National Assembly elections were held in the Philippines on September 20, 1943 for the elected and appointed representative to the newly created National Assembly of the Second Philippine Republic which replaced the National Assembly of the Philippines of the Commonwealth of the Philippines. The Commonwealth government was exiled in Washington, D.C. upon the invitation of Pres. Roosevelt. The Japanese took over Manila on January 2, 1942 and soon established the Japanese Military Administration to replace the exiled Commonwealth government. It utilized the existing administrative structure already in place and coerced high-ranking Commonwealth officials left behind to form a government.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1943年9月20日举行国民议会选举，选出并任命第二菲律宾共和国新设国民议会的代表；该议会取代了菲律宾联邦时期的国民议会。罗斯福总统邀请菲律宾联邦政府流亡至华盛顿特区。1942年1月2日，日本占领马尼拉，随后设立日本军政部，取代流亡的联邦政府。日本当局沿用当地现有的行政架构，并胁迫留在菲律宾的高级联邦政府官员组建政府。

en.s: The Battle of Kaiapit was an action fought in 1943 between Australian and Japanese forces in New Guinea during the Markham and Ramu Valley – Finisterre Range campaign of World War II. Following the landings at Nadzab and at Lae, the Allies attempted to exploit their success with an advance into the upper Markham Valley, starting with Kaiapit.

zh.s: 凯亚皮特战役是1943年新几内亚的一场战斗，交战双方为澳大利亚和日本军队，战事属于第二次世界大战中的马克姆河与拉穆河谷-芬尼斯特雷山脉战役。盟军在纳扎布和莱城登陆后，试图乘胜推进至马克姆河上游，首先向凯亚皮特进军。

en.s: The Battle of Nijmegen, also known as the Liberation of Nijmegen, occurred from 17 to 20 September 1944, as part of Operation Market Garden during World War II. The Allies' primary goal was to capture the two bridges over the Waal River at Nijmegen – the road route over the Waalbrug (Waal Bridge) and Nijmegen railway bridge – and relieve the British 1st Airborne Division and Polish 1st Independent Parachute Brigade at Arnhem, 10 miles (16 km) north of Nijmegen.

en.t: Greek general Konstantinos Dovas becomes Prime Minister of Greece
en.s: Konstantinos Dovas (Greek: Κωνσταντίνος Δόβας; 20 December 1898 – 24 July 1973) was a Greek general and interim Prime Minister. en.s: The 1982 NFL season was the 63rd regular season of the National Football League. A 57-day-long players' strike reduced the 1982 season from a 16-game schedule per team to an abbreviated nine-game schedule. en.s: South Ossetia, formally known as the State of Alania since 2017, or originally the Republic of South Ossetia, is a partially recognised state in the South Caucasus. en.s: Operation Deliberate Force was a sustained air campaign conducted by the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (NATO), in concert with the United Nations Protection Force (UNPROFOR) ground operations, to undermine the military capability of the Bosnian Serb Army (VRS), which had threatened and attacked UN-designated "safe areas" in Bosnia and Herzegovina during the Bosnian War with the Srebrenica and Markale massacres, precipitating the intervention. Smith, the campaign struck 338 Bosnian Serb targets, many of which were destroyed.

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 20 September 1998. The Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party in the Riksdag, winning 131 of the 349 seats. en.s: The Islamabad Marriott Hotel bombing occurred during the night of 20 September 2008, when a dump truck filled with explosives detonated in front of the Marriott Hotel in the Pakistani capital Islamabad, killing at least 54 people, injuring at least 266 and leaving a 60 ft (20 m) wide, 20 ft (6 m) deep crater outside the hotel. The majority of the casualties were Pakistanis; although at least five foreign nationals were killed and fifteen others reported injured. The attack occurred mere hours after President Asif Ali Zardari made his first speech to the Pakistani parliament.The Marriott hotel was the most prestigious hotel in the capital, located near government buildings, diplomatic missions, embassies and high commissions.

en.s: The 2014 New Zealand general election took place on Saturday 20 September 2014 to determine the membership of the 51st New Zealand Parliament. Voters elected 121 members to the House of Representatives, with 71 from single-member electorates (an increase from 70 in 2011) and 49 from party lists. Since 1996, New Zealand has used the Mixed Member Proportional (MMP) voting system, giving voters two votes: one for a political party and one for their local electorate MP. The party vote decides how many seats each party gets in the new Parliament; a party is entitled to a share of the seats if it receives 5% of the party vote or wins an electorate.

zh.s: 新西兰于2014年9月20日（星期六）举行大选，选出第51届新西兰议会。选民选出121名众议院议员，其中71人来自单一选区（2011年为70席），49人通过政党名单产生。自1996年以来，新西兰一直实行混合成员比例代表制（MMP），选民有两票：一票投给政党，一票投给所在选区的议员候选人。政党票决定各党在新一届议会中的席位数；政党须获得5%的政党票，或赢得一个选区，才有资格按比例分配席位。

en.s: Night of Champions (2015) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on September 20, 2015 at Toyota Center in Houston, Texas. It was the ninth and final event under the Night of Champions chronology. This was the second Night of Champions event to be held in Houston, after Vengeance: Night of Champions in 2007. Eight matches were contested at the event, with one match on the pre-show. In the main event, Seth Rollins defeated Sting to retain the WWE World Heavyweight Championship. en.s: General elections were held in Jordan on 20 September 2016 to elect the 18th Lower House of Parliament. The elections were announced after parliament was dissolved by King Abdullah II of Jordan on 29 May 2016, with the King appointing Hani Al-Mulki as interim Prime Minister following the resignation of Abdullah Ensour. Following electoral reforms announced in 2015, these elections were the first since 1989 to be held primarily under a form of proportional representation; intervening elections were held under the “one-man one-vote” system, which systematically disadvantaged Islamic political parties, after they managed to obtain 22 seats out of 80 in 1989.

zh.s: 约旦于2016年9月20日举行大选，选出第18届众议院议员。2016年5月29日，阿卜杜拉二世国王解散议会后宣布举行选举；阿卜杜拉·恩苏尔辞职后，国王任命哈尼·穆勒奇为临时首相。2015年宣布的选举改革实施后，这是自1989年以来首次主要采用比例代表制举行的选举。1989年至此次选举之间举行的各次选举采用“一人一票”制度，该制度系统性地使伊斯兰政党处于不利地位；这些政党在1989年曾赢得80席中的22席。

en.s: The 2025 Wrestlepalooza, also promoted as Wrestlepalooza: Indianapolis, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the fifth Wrestlepalooza, although the first under the WWE banner, and the first since 2000, which was produced by the former Extreme Championship Wrestling, the assets of which WWE acquired in 2003. The event took place on September 20, 2025, at the Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, Indiana.
